responsibility: Manages user registration, login/logout, session identity, role distinction (regular user vs administrator), and provides administrator-role validation used by other services to gate restricted operations (RF-01..RF-07, RF-34, RNF-45, RNF-46, RNF-47, RNF-55). Backed by UserController and user persistence. Serves as the authoritative authorization gate to close the RNF-60 backend-enforcement gap.

Handles movie catalog browsing (paginated listing with title, poster, rating), per-movie details with full metadata and cast, category-based discovery (browse/filter by category, multi-category movies), and administrative catalog management (register, delete single/batch, duplicate-title prevention, confirmation). Consults the User and Access Service to validate administrator role before executing register/delete operations (RF-06, RF-26, RF-30..RF-33, RNF-46). Backed by MovieController and TypeController over movie and category persistence.

responsibility: Manages movie video uploads (up to 2 GB MP4), ensures video availability in the delivery area with fallback to the configured local repository, provides playback start and download links based on filename-pattern conventions. Consults the User and Access Service to validate administrator role before executing upload operations (RF-29, RNF-46). Backed by MovieUploadController and file utilities/properties.
